derivation:
by
  simpa using (IsWeightedHomogeneous.sum {true, false} (fun b : Bool => if b then φ else ψ) n
    (by intro b _; cases b <;> assumption))
explanation: Specialize the finite-sum theorem to two Boolean-indexed polynomials. Its proof uses Submodule.sum_mem directly and does not depend on the theorem being judged.
